description:
Escapade is our UK made gravel bike. Smooth Supple Speed. Reynolds 853 steel, 700x50 tyres, Sureshot geometry.
Fast feels different on a Cotic. The best Reynolds 853 steel, shaped and honed by us, brings compliance that makes you faster. It keeps you fresh for hours, your mind and legs sharp, delivering long range pace to your big rides.
The Ride
Escapade is calm, compliant and efficient when covering the miles, but it has sharp wits ready for action when the trail starts to twist. Breathing with the trail over rough sections, but quick to change direction when you need it to.
Descending is where the Escapade leaves the competition behind. Cotic Sureshot geometry is confidence inspiring, encouraging, and just so damn fast! The bike always has a glint in its eye. Charismatic. It makes hard days feel shorter, and long ones feel dreamy. High performance doesn't have to be dull.
Not All Steel Is Equal
Reynolds 853 is a special heat-treated steel, stronger than standard cromoly, which lets us use thinner walls and build a lighter, more compliant frame without losing the toughness steel is known for. On the Escapade we go further with a custom blend: a Reynolds 853 front triangle, Columbus chainstays and custom made T45 seatstays, each tube chosen for its job. Every Escapade frame is hand made and finished in Britain by Five Land Bikes in Scotland.

Key details

Custom blend tubeset - Reynolds 853 front triangle with Ovalform top tube, Columbus chainstays, custom made T45 seatstays. Tough, durable, clean, graceful.
British made and finished frame. A La Carte custom paint options.
Cotic designed 3D Printed dropouts incorporate the latest UDH/Full Mount compatibility, thru axle, FM160 brake and integrated rack/fender bosses.
Mounts: Rear Full Rack, mudguards, 3 x bottles on frame, Anything Cage bosses on fork legs.
All new Cotic steel fork. Bespoke heat-treated cromoly, 1 1/8" steerer for smooth ride and low weight, clearance for 700x55 tyre.
Custom Works x Cotic flush fit headset works with the Cotic fork to keep the look sharp and integrated, whilst 44mm head tube allows for taper steerer suspension forks as an option.
700x50 tyre compatibility.
Completely new, proportional fit Cotic Sureshot geometry. Designed around 70mm stems and slacker head angles, the geometry is more stable and confident offroad, whilst the shorter stem dials in the agility. It's simply better everywhere.
No toe overlap on any size.
40mm suspension fork compatible geometry.
27.2mm diameter seatpost is more compliant than the larger options.
Routing for dropper posts.
68mm threaded BB shell. Chainline is 47.5mm.
Custom 3D printed removable cable management for clean lines when running wireless transmissions.
